result.instructions: Tools for Bokio, hosted by usefulapi.io. If the user is new or asks what this server can do, suggest requests such as: "Show the company's fiscal years and chart of accounts."; "List invoices and show the details of one invoice."; "Create an invoice draft for an existing customer.". Read-only tools never change data; ask the user before a tool that creates, changes or deletes Bokio data. Free plan: 50 tool calls per month. Run bokio_usage_status to see the calls used this month. If the user asks for something none of these tools can do, tell the user and, with their OK, run bokio_request_feature to record the request. Paid plan: Pro (unlimited tool calls (fair use limit: 10,000 a month), $9/month or $90/year). Pro can be cancelled at any time and then runs to the end of the paid period, so it also suits a one-time job. When the user wants more calls or reaches the limit, run bokio_upgrade (plan "monthly" or "yearly"); it returns a payment link for the user to open. bokio_cancel_subscription cancels Pro at the end of the paid period.

tools.name: bokio_get_company_information
tools.title: Get company information
tools.description: The connected Bokio company: name, organisation number, company type, address, contact details.

tools.name: bokio_list_fiscal_years
tools.title: List fiscal years
tools.description: Fiscal years (id, start and end date, cash or accrual accounting method, open or closed).

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: startDate, endDate, accountingMethod, status. Example: status==open

tools.name: bokio_get_fiscal_year
tools.title: Get a fiscal year
tools.description: One fiscal year by id.

tools.name: bokio_list_chart_of_accounts
tools.title: List chart of accounts
tools.description: The company's complete chart of accounts (account number, name, base-plan or custom). Not paginated.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: account, name, accountType. Example: account>=3000&&account<4000

tools.name: bokio_get_account
tools.title: Get an account
tools.description: One account of the chart of accounts by its number (for example 1930).

tools.name: bokio_list_journal_entries
tools.title: List journal entries
tools.description: Bookkeeping journal entries (verifications) with their debit/credit lines. Filter by date or number.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: date, journalEntryNumber, title, reversedByJournalEntryId, reversingJournalEntryId. Example: date>=2024-01-01&&date<=2024-12-31

tools.name: bokio_get_journal_entry
tools.title: Get a journal entry
tools.description: One journal entry (verification) with its lines.

tools.name: bokio_list_customers
tools.title: List customers
tools.description: Customers of the company, highest customer number first.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: name, customerNumber, type, vatNumber, orgNumber, modifiedDateTime. Example: name~Acme

tools.name: bokio_get_customer
tools.title: Get a customer
tools.description: One customer by id.

tools.name: bokio_list_invoices
tools.title: List invoices
tools.description: Sales invoices (draft, published, paid, overdue, credited) with line items and totals.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: type, status, invoiceDate, dueDate, customerRef.id, customerRef.customerNumber, orderNumberReference, projectReference, buyerReference, contractReference, currency, totalAmount. Example: status==overdue

tools.name: bokio_get_invoice
tools.title: Get an invoice
tools.description: One sales invoice by id, with line items.

tools.name: bokio_list_invoice_payments
tools.title: List invoice payments
tools.description: Payments registered against one sales invoice.

tools.name: bokio_list_credit_notes
tools.title: List credit notes
tools.description: Credit notes (draft or published).

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: type, status, creditDate, dueDate, customerRef, orderNumberReference, projectReference, buyerReference, contractReference, currency, totalAmount. Example: status==published

tools.name: bokio_get_credit_note
tools.title: Get a credit note
tools.description: One credit note by id, with line items.

tools.name: bokio_list_items
tools.title: List items (products and services)
tools.description: Reusable invoice items: description, product type, unit price, tax rate, bookkeeping account.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: description, itemType, productType, unitType, unitPrice, taxRate. Example: productType==services

tools.name: bokio_list_suppliers
tools.title: List suppliers
tools.description: Suppliers of the company with payment details.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: name, vatNumber, orgNumber. Example: name~Telia

tools.name: bokio_list_supplier_invoices
tools.title: List supplier invoices
tools.description: Supplier (purchase) invoices with remaining amounts and their journal entry.

query.description: Optional Bokio filter: property, operator, value, joined with && (operators ==, !=, <, <=, >, >=, ~ for contains). Filterable fields: supplierRef.id, invoiceNumber, invoiceDate, dueDate, totalAmount, currency. Example: dueDate<2024-12-31

tools.name: bokio_create_customer
tools.title: Create a customer
tools.description: Create a customer in the company's Bokio. If customerNumber is omitted Bokio picks the next number. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two customers; check bokio_list_customers first.

paymentTerms.description: Payment terms in days, as Bokio expects, for example 30.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country code, for example SE.

countrySubdivision.description: ISO 3166-2 subdivision code (ENG, SCT, WLS, NIR). Required by Bokio when country is GB.

tools.name: bokio_create_invoice_draft
tools.title: Create an invoice draft
tools.description: Create a DRAFT sales invoice. Nothing is bookkept and nothing is sent until bokio_publish_invoice. Not idempotent: calling twice creates two drafts.

customerId.description: The customer id from bokio_list_customers (a GUID).

currencyRate.description: Rate to SEK when the currency is not SEK.

description.description: Line text. With itemId Bokio uses the saved item's own description and ignores this one.

customUnitType.description: The unit label when unitType is custom, for example session.

itemType.description: salesItem (default) is a priced line; descriptionOnlyItem is a text line.

productType.description: Required for a salesItem line without itemId.

unitPrice.description: Price per unit excluding VAT. Required for a salesItem line without itemId; with itemId it overrides the item's price.

taxRate.description: VAT percentage, for example 25. Required for a salesItem line without itemId.

itemId.description: A saved item (GUID). Bokio then takes product type, unit, VAT rate and account from the item; only quantity and unitPrice can be set on the line.

bookkeepingAccountNumber.description: Revenue account; Bokio uses the default when omitted. Not allowed together with itemId.

tools.name: bokio_publish_invoice
tools.title: Publish an invoice (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: publish a draft invoice. It becomes official and immutable and gets its invoice number. This does NOT bookkeep it (use bokio_record_invoice for that) and Bokio does NOT e-mail it to the customer through the API. Only call when the user has confirmed this exact invoice.

tools.name: bokio_record_invoice
tools.title: Bookkeep an invoice (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: record (bookkeep) a published invoice: Bokio posts it to the ledger using the accounts of its line items. Call after bokio_publish_invoice, only when the user has confirmed.

tools.name: bokio_create_journal_entry
tools.title: Create a journal entry (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE bookkeeping: post a journal entry (verification) to the ledger. Debits must equal credits. It can only be undone by reversing it with bokio_reverse_journal_entry, which posts a counter-entry. Not idempotent: calling twice posts two entries. Only call when the user has confirmed the exact lines.

date.description: Booking date, inside an open fiscal year (YYYY-MM-DD).

account.description: Account number from the chart of accounts.

debit.description: Debit amount (0 if this is a credit line).

credit.description: Credit amount (0 if this is a debit line).

tools.name: bokio_reverse_journal_entry
tools.title: Reverse a journal entry (IRREVERSIBLE)
tools.description: IRREVERSIBLE: post a counter-entry that cancels a journal entry. Only entries created through the API can be reversed; the original stays in the ledger. Only call when the user has confirmed.
